content: Sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitors are typically recommended for patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) who also have type 2 diabetes (T2D) and exhibit significant albuminuria (high levels of albumin in the urine). These medications are also advised for individuals with a documented reduction in estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR), as they have demonstrated clinical benefits even in patients with advanced stages of CKD.
